## 2. Core Services Breakdown

### 2.1 Performance Marketing & Social Media
- Focus: Paid media campaigns (Meta, Google, LinkedIn), audience targeting, conversion rate optimization, and social media growth.
- URL: https://brandelier.in/services/social-media-marketing

### 2.2 Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Focus: Technical audits, on-page optimization, content strategy, link profile building, and localized search dominance in Pune and pan-India.
- URL: https://brandelier.in/services/seo-optimization

### 2.3 Web Design & Custom Web Development
- Focus: Modern responsive websites, performant digital experiences, conversion-first UX/UI, Astro, WordPress headless, and bespoke web platforms.
- URL: https://brandelier.in/services/web-development

### 2.4 Brand Design & Visual Strategy
- Focus: Complete brand identity systems, logos, typography, visual hierarchy, color theory, and comprehensive brand books.
- URL: https://brandelier.in/services/brand-design

### 2.5 Content Marketing & Editorial
- Focus: Thought leadership articles, copywriting, narrative storytelling, content funnels, and customer retention systems.
- URL: https://brandelier.in/services/content-marketing

### 2.6 Videography & Photography Production
- Focus: Commercial studio sets, brand documentary films, short-form reels, high-end product photography, and post-production editing.
- URL: https://brandelier.in/services/videography-photography

## 3. Our Four-Step Approach

1. Discovery & Strategy: Research-driven strategies tailored to your target audience and competitive landscape.
2. Design & Development: Beautiful, functional, user-first creative and digital executions.
3. Marketing & Promotion: Multi-channel distribution to build organic reach and convert traffic.
4. Monitoring & Optimization: Continuous data-led refinement to scale ROI and compound growth.
